rules: External author-reported results are permitted; reproducing every baseline is not required.
Keep stronger variants and training-data differences visible; do not choose weak rows to manufacture superiority.
Null means unreported, not zero. Preserve original reported precision; display formatting is separate.
PVE alignment and acceleration units vary across original sources; these columns are provenance inventory, not an automatically comparable ranking.
The current C10 validation numbers are not inserted as a test row. A verified corresponding test evaluation is still required.
